question.text: Effective tax rate on F&O income for a Trust Cat III AIF (income > Rs. 2 crore) is approximately:

explanation.text: The Logic: Effective = 30% × 1.25 (surcharge) × 1.04 (cess) = 39.00% approximately. The Trap: Base 30% excludes surcharge/cess; 15%/12.5% are CG rates. Cross-Exam Context: Critical for return modeling. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Plan investor communication around 39% effective rate, not 30% base.
